description:
Check an industrial graph spec before create_graph: only allowed node types, correct wiring,
        passive settings (no equipment writes) and a readable layout. Returns the problems to fix.
        Example: review_industrial_solution(spec=<the spec from compose_industrial_solution>).

spec.description: A graph spec (as returned by compose_industrial_solution or written by you) to check before create_graph.
spec.title: Spec
